g.text: apartment_id : UUID «FK, ON DELETE RESTRICT, unique»
= NOT NULL, PK = primary key, FK = foreign key
Turns start on the sauna's grid: opens_at + n * turn_length_minutes.
So two turns of the same sauna overlap only if they start at the
same time, so a UNIQUE constraint on the start time is enough.
weekly_turns.apartment_id unique: one weekly fixed turn per apartment.
bookings UNIQUE (sauna_id, starts_at): bookings never overlap.
Booking vs weekly turn (two tables): checked in the use case while
the sauna row is locked (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE), so concurrent
writes to the same sauna run one after another.
RESTRICT: an apartment or sauna with turns/bookings cannot be
deleted -> API returns 409. Residents are deleted with their apartment.
Opening hours / turn length cannot be changed while the sauna
has weekly turns or future bookings.
